title: DolphinRide
description: A plugin that allows you to ride dolphins, achieving fast movement across the water.
body:
**🐬Dolphin riding**
DolphinRide -- Allows you to ride dolphins with a high custom Speed. Dolphins can now be mounted like regular animals and ridden on the water🌊

**💨Speeds:**
Dolphin speed can be adjusted in Minecraft. By default, the speed is:
22 blocks per second
If the player drinks different potions, the dolphin will become faster:
- 🧪Speed ​​Potion 1: 40 blocks per second
- 🧪Speed ​​Potion 2: 60 blocks per second
- Speeds can be changed in "config.yml"


```
base: 1.1 #1.1 * 20 = 22 Speed
speed_i: 2.0 #2.0 * 20 = 40 Speed
speed_ii: 3.0 #3.0 * 20 = 60 Speed
```


For example, if you set the
```
base: 1.6
```
The dolphin's speed without a potion on the player will be:
32 blocks per second

**⚠️BE CAREFUL**. The plugin will put a heavy load on your server if you set the Dolphin speed to High


**🎮Control:**
- To mount a dolphin, approach it and right-click.
- To dismount, press Shift.
- To begin movement after mounting the dolphin, look as far up as possible (90-degree angle).
(The dolphin has automatic acceleration.)
- To slow down while riding the dolphin, look down.
- To completely stop the dolphin in one place, after coming to a complete stop at 0 blocks per second, look at the floor at a -90-degree angle for 2 seconds.
- To release the dolphin's handbrake, look as far up as possible for 2 seconds.
- To make the dolphin swim where you want, simply aim in that direction.
